# `silk/tls/trust_source_windows`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

A `TrustSource` provider for the current user's Windows `ROOT` certificate store.

## When to use

Provide `WindowsRootTrustSource` explicitly when a TLS client should trust certificates in
the Windows logical `ROOT` store, including machine roots exposed through that store.

## Details

Each load opens the existing store read-only, copies every certificate, and closes the store.
Snapshots own their certificates. Enumeration order is unspecified, and the store may change
during enumeration. A malformed certificate fails the whole load; none are silently skipped.

## Gotchas

This imports certificate anchors, not Windows chain-engine policy. It does not import store
properties, usage restrictions, the disallowed store, revocation policy, or automatic root
updates. Silk's TLS verifier checks the resulting chain. The provider is available on Windows
x86_64 MSVC and is never installed implicitly.
